stimulus.title: The region <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>R</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R</annotation></semantics></math> between <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = 6x - x^2</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = x^2</annotation></semantics></math>

parts.label: a

rubric.point: Integral: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>3</mn></msubsup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int_0^3 \left(6x - 2x^2\right)\,dx</annotation></semantics></math>, with limits from <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f(x) = g(x)</annotation></semantics></math>
accept: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>3</mn></msubsup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">[</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">]</mo></mrow><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int_0^3 \left[(6x - x^2) - x^2\right]\,dx</annotation></semantics></math>

the limits 0 and 3 must come from solving <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">6x - x^2 = x^2</annotation></semantics></math>

parts.sample: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">6x - x^2 = x^2</annotation></semantics></math> gives <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2x^2 - 6x = 2x(x - 3) = 0</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = 0</annotation></semantics></math> or <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = 3</annotation></semantics></math>. At <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = 1</annotation></semantics></math>, <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>f</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>></mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mi>g</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f = 5 > 1 = g</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>f</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f</annotation></semantics></math> is on top. Area <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>3</mn></msubsup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \int_0^3 \left(6x - 2x^2\right)\,dx</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><msubsup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">[</mo><mrow><mn>3</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup></mrow><mn>3</mn></mfrac></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">]</mo></mrow><mn>0</mn><mn>3</mn></msubsup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \left[3x^2 - \frac{2x^3}{3}\right]_0^3</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>27</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>18</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 27 - 18</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>9</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 9</annotation></semantics></math>.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the volume of the solid generated when RR is revolved about the horizontal line y=−1y = -1.

accept: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>π</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\pi</annotation></semantics></math> in front of an integral from 0 to 3

rubric.point: Integrand: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><msup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\left(6x - x^2 + 1\right)^2 - \left(x^2 + 1\right)^2</annotation></semantics></math>
accept: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><msup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\left(f(x) + 1\right)^2 - \left(g(x) + 1\right)^2</annotation></semantics></math>

radii measured from <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = 0</annotation></semantics></math>, or <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>f</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>g</mi><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(f - g)^2</annotation></semantics></math>, do not earn this point

parts.sample: From <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = -1</annotation></semantics></math>, the outer radius is <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f(x) + 1 = 6x - x^2 + 1</annotation></semantics></math> and the inner radius is <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">g(x) + 1 = x^2 + 1</annotation></semantics></math>. As a difference of squares, <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">(6x - x^2 + 1)^2 - (x^2 + 1)^2</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= (6x - 2x^2)(6x + 2)</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>12</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>32</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>12</mn><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= -12x^3 + 32x^2 + 12x</annotation></semantics></math>. Volume <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>π</mi><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>3</mn></msubsup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>12</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>32</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>12</mn><mi>x</mi></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \pi\int_0^3 \left(-12x^3 + 32x^2 + 12x\right)\,dx</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>π</mi><msubsup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">[</mo><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>3</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>4</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>32</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup></mrow><mn>3</mn></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">]</mo></mrow><mn>0</mn><mn>3</mn></msubsup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \pi\left[-3x^4 + \frac{32x^3}{3} + 6x^2\right]_0^3</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>π</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>243</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>288</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>54</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \pi(-243 + 288 + 54)</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>99</mn><mi>π</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 99\pi</annotation></semantics></math>.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Region RR is the base of a solid. For this solid, each cross section perpendicular to the xx-axis is a semicircle whose diameter lies in RR. Write, but do not evaluate, an integral expression for the volume of the solid.

accept: a radius of <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">6x - 2x^2</annotation></semantics></math>, or a full circle, does not earn this point

rubric.point: Limits and the integral: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>3</mn></msubsup><mo>…</mo><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int_0^3 \ldots\,dx</annotation></semantics></math>

parts.sample: The diameter at <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x</annotation></semantics></math> is <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>−</mo><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f(x) - g(x) = 6x - 2x^2</annotation></semantics></math>, so the radius is <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">3x - x^2</annotation></semantics></math> and the semicircle's area is <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mi>π</mi><msup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{1}{2}\pi\left(3x - x^2\right)^2</annotation></semantics></math>. Volume <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>3</mn></msubsup><mfrac><mi>π</mi><mn>2</mn></mfrac><msup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \int_0^3 \frac{\pi}{2}\left(3x - x^2\right)^2\,dx</annotation></semantics></math>.

parts.label: d
parts.prompt: Write, but do not evaluate, an integral expression for the volume of the solid generated when RR is revolved about the vertical line x=−1x = -1. (For 0≤x≤30 \le x \le 3, the graph of ff is also the graph of x=3−9−yx = 3 - \sqrt{9 - y}.)

rubric.point: Radii in terms of <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y</annotation></semantics></math>: outer <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msqrt><mi>y</mi></msqrt><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sqrt{y} + 1</annotation></semantics></math>, inner <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>−</mo><msqrt><mrow><mn>9</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>y</mi></mrow></msqrt></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">4 - \sqrt{9 - y}</annotation></semantics></math>
accept: the right edge <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mi>y</mi></msqrt></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = \sqrt{y}</annotation></semantics></math> and the left edge <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>−</mo><msqrt><mrow><mn>9</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>y</mi></mrow></msqrt></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = 3 - \sqrt{9 - y}</annotation></semantics></math>, each plus 1
edges written in terms of <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x</annotation></semantics></math> do not earn this point

rubric.point: Integral expression: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>π</mi><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>9</mn></msubsup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">[</mo><mrow><msup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><msqrt><mi>y</mi></msqrt><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><msup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>−</mo><msqrt><mrow><mn>9</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>y</mi></mrow></msqrt></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">]</mo></mrow><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\pi\int_0^9 \left[\left(\sqrt{y} + 1\right)^2 - \left(4 - \sqrt{9 - y}\right)^2\right]\,dy</annotation></semantics></math>
accept: the constant <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>π</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\pi</annotation></semantics></math>, limits 0 and 9 in <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">dy</annotation></semantics></math>, and outer squared minus inner squared

parts.sample: Horizontal washers for <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>≤</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>≤</mo><mn>9</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0 \le y \le 9</annotation></semantics></math>. The right edge of <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>R</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">R</annotation></semantics></math> is <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>g</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">g</annotation></semantics></math>: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mi>y</mi></msqrt></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = \sqrt{y}</annotation></semantics></math>. The left edge is <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>f</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f</annotation></semantics></math>: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>9</mn><mo>−</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = 9 - (x - 3)^2</annotation></semantics></math> gives <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>−</mo><msqrt><mrow><mn>9</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>y</mi></mrow></msqrt></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = 3 - \sqrt{9 - y}</annotation></semantics></math> on <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>≤</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>≤</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">0 \le x \le 3</annotation></semantics></math>. From the axis <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x = -1</annotation></semantics></math>, the outer radius is <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msqrt><mi>y</mi></msqrt><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sqrt{y} + 1</annotation></semantics></math> and the inner radius is <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>−</mo><msqrt><mrow><mn>9</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>y</mi></mrow></msqrt><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">3 - \sqrt{9 - y} + 1</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>−</mo><msqrt><mrow><mn>9</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>y</mi></mrow></msqrt></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= 4 - \sqrt{9 - y}</annotation></semantics></math>. Volume <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>π</mi><msubsup><mo largeop="true" movablelimits="false">∫</mo><mn>0</mn><mn>9</mn></msubsup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">[</mo><mrow><msup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><msqrt><mi>y</mi></msqrt><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><msup><mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">(</mo><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>−</mo><msqrt><mrow><mn>9</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>y</mi></mrow></msqrt></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><mo fence="true" stretchy="true">]</mo></mrow><mspace width="0.1667em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= \pi\int_0^9 \left[\left(\sqrt{y} + 1\right)^2 - \left(4 - \sqrt{9 - y}\right)^2\right]\,dy</annotation></semantics></math>.
